label: Line Chart
description: A trend told as a draw: gridlines settle, each series draws left to right with its area wiping in, a dot rides the tip, and the final value lands big at the end of the line. Up to 4 series with a legend (us vs them, this year vs last); a highlight marks the moment that matters with a pill. Themed from the ground; type sized for video.

series.label: Series: [{ name, color?, points: [numbers] or [{ y, label? }] }] -- up to 4. Use this for two lines (e.g. 'With Quotient' vs 'Before').

points.label: Single-series shorthand: [{ x, y }] or [{ label, y }]

highlight.label: { index or label, text?, at? } -- a dashed marker and a pill at that point

y_min.label: Force the axis minimum (default 0 or the lowest value)

area.label: Area fill under the lines (default on)

draw.label: Seconds each line takes to draw (default 1.6)

color.label: Line color for the single-series shorthand
